title: Add people to a group
summary: Picks people for a group: from the user's contacts or by an exact @. In pick mode it returns the people to group-create; in invite mode it invites them to an existing group.

status.description: selectable: can be picked. selected: picked now. member: already in the group (bipe_dm_invite_to_group_already_member, not selectable). invited: has a pending invite, or the invite just went out (bipe_dm_invite_to_group_sent). refused: the server refused the invite (bipe_app_group_invite_refused). failed: another error (bipe_app_group_invite_error).

mode.description: pick: from group-create, nothing is sent. invite: from group-details or group-members, for an existing group.

query.description: The search text. Empty shows the contacts.

contacts.description: The user's contacts that match query, by name or @ (see notes). Sorted by name.

handleMatch.description: The holder of the exact @ in query, when query is an @ and the lookup found one.

handleNotFound.description: true when query is a valid @ and the lookup found nobody: bipe_start_chat_handle_not_found.

selectedCount.description: People with status selected. The invite button is off at 0.

phase.description: choosing: the list. inviting: invite mode, the invites are going out. done: invite mode, every selected person has a result.

setQuery.effect: Filters contacts at once. When the text is a valid @ (handle rules of registries/handles.json), looks it up with GET /v1/handles/{handle} after a short pause and fills handleMatch or handleNotFound.

toggle.effect: selectable becomes selected, selected becomes selectable. Other statuses do nothing.

invite.effect: pick mode: returns the selected people to group-create and closes. invite mode: Room.inviteUserById for each selected person, one at a time; each row shows its result. When all succeed, closes and shows bipe_dm_invite_to_group_sent.

inviteSomeoneNew.effect: Opens invites (a personal Bipe invite) for a person who is not on Bipe yet.

cancel.effect: Closes. pick mode keeps the people group-create had.

notes: Contacts are the people the user already talks to: the other person of each DM (Client.getDmRoom answers which), the members of the user's groups, invite pairs (GET /v1/me/invite-connections, ADR 0034) and, when phone discovery is on, the address-book matches of POST /v1/contacts/lookup. This is the same set that the who-can-message setting counts as contacts (ADR 0038), so these invites are not refused. Bipe logic: BipeInvitePairs (libraries/bipe invites), BipeInviteToGroup (libraries/bipe groups) and BipeHandleResolver (BipeKit, libraries/bipe).

No user directory search. Client.searchUsers is not used: Bipe finds people by exact @ only, with no directory and no search (bipe_start_chat_search_by_handle, ADR 0013). The @ in the row comes from POST /v1/handles/resolve.
invite mode needs RoomPowerLevels.canOwnUserInvite. Without it, group-details and group-members hide the entry to this screen.
Statuses member and invited come from the group's members (MembershipState join and invite).
A refused invite is a server error from the who-can-message module (Synapse, ADR 0038). Show bipe_app_group_invite_refused with the person's name. Never say which setting the person chose.
A DM cannot gain people from this screen (ADR 0141). To make a group with the other person of a DM, the DM details open group-create with that person picked.
Display names follow Person.displayName. Trust marks (badges, the business seal) on the rows come with the people specs (bipe-chat/bipe#567).
